project_type: Bun server (Bun.serve HTTP API) with SQLite persistence, prompt-injection firewall
build_system: Bun — no build step needed; TypeScript runs directly. No bundler, no transpiler.
test_framework: bun:test (built-in, import from bun:test). Tests live in tests/*.test.ts
build_command: No separate build step; bun runs .ts directly. Dev server: bun run dev (port 3000).
test_command: bun test (runs with DB_PATH=./warden-test.db via package.json script)
verification_instructions: 1. Run `bun test` — all 129+ tests must pass. 2. Verify new scripts appear in package.json. 3. Manually verify new API routes respond (bun run dev + curl). 4. ONNX embedding model crashes in bun:test, so model-dependent paths (embed/similarity) cannot be unit-tested — pure-logic tests only.
environment_constraints: ONNX runtime crashes inside bun:test (C++ exception). Tests that need embeddings use synthetic vectors via the vec() helper pattern found in tests/memory.test.ts and tests/similarity.test.ts. The red team runner requires the API server running on port 3000 (bun run dev). LLM-dependent features require ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or OPENROUTER_API_KEY in env.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing code style: JSDoc on exports, bun:sqlite for DB, crypto.randomUUID() for IDs, getDb() singleton from src/store/db.ts.

key_patterns.db_access: All DB access through getDb() from src/store/db.ts. Schema is CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS in getDb(). New tables go there. Column migrations use ALTER TABLE wrapped in try-catch.
key_patterns.memory_system: MemoryRecord has id/label/attackType/vector/text/source/sourceId/status/origin/confirmations/agentId. Origins: human|judge|rules|redteam|seed. Statuses: probation|active|retired. Human+seed skip probation (start active). Others need PROMOTION_THRESHOLD (2) confirmations.
key_patterns.similarity: addReference() and addSafeReference() in src/detect/similarity.ts. They dedup against all memories (not just active) at DUPLICATE_THRESHOLD=0.95. invalidateReferenceCache() must be called after mutations.
key_patterns.review_queue: enqueueReview() only queues HUMAN_REVIEW and QUARANTINE actions. markResolved(id, decision, note). POST /review/:id already calls addReference/addSafeReference for attack/safe decisions.
key_patterns.test_pattern: import from bun:test. Use beforeEach to clean test agent rows. Synthetic vectors via vec(seed) pattern from EMBEDDING_DIMS. Agent isolation via unique agent IDs per test file.
key_patterns.api_pattern: Bun.serve routes object. Each route is { METHOD: async (req) => Response.json(...) }. Params via req.params.
key_patterns.eval_cases: JSON arrays in eval/cases/*.json. Each: { id, source, content, label, expected_attacks, expected_action, notes }. 186 malicious + 63 benign across 6 files.
key_patterns.redteam: mutations.ts exports MUTATIONS array (Mutation[]) and mutationOrder(). provider.ts exports getProvider() and BudgetedClient class. No runner/scheduler yet.

directory_structure: src/detect/ — detection pipeline (orchestrator, similarity, rules, classifier, judge, laya, session, embeddings). src/store/ — persistence (db, memory, review, reputation). src/api/ — HTTP routes and analytics. src/extract/ — content extraction. src/decode/ — encoding detection. src/guard/ — output guard and tool checking. src/policy/ — per-agent policy. redteam/ — mutation engine + LLM provider (no runner yet). eval/ — evaluation framework. tests/ — bun:test suite. dashboard/ — HTML dashboard.
